notes: Long dictations keep every sentence. Past 30 seconds Hex could drop a sentence here and there, most often in German and Spanish; that is fixed.
Contractions typed without their apostrophe come out right: itd gives it'd, thatd gives that'd, and eleven more.

The keyboard's menu now shows the language Automatic will dictate in, such as Automatic · English. It follows the keyboard's language, so pick yours under Dictation language if you speak a different one.
